column1: Module Name: SRS-MRAD-001 Software Requirements Specification

column4: This specification establishes the requirements for the Computer Software Configuration Item (CSCI) identified as the MRAD Arresting Control Software, CSCI number 7429-01.
The CSCI shall command the retarding force setpoint within 40 ms of receiving a valid ENGAGE discrete, where "valid" means two of three channels agree.
The CSCI shall limit commanded retarding force to 1,250 kN under all operating conditions, including degraded sensor modes.

The CSCI shall record each arrestment event to non-volatile storage.

Each record shall contain the event timestamp, peak retarding force, and the identity of the commanding channel.
Table 1 defines the allocated latency budget for each external interface. The CSCI shall not exceed the values in Table 1.
Table 2 maps each requirement in section 3 to its verification method and the test procedure that satisfies it.
